content.short: First real buildable character NFT on the Cardano Blockchain. Handmade and strictly limited on 1600 NFTs.
content.description: ADAHEADZ are handmade Cardano-based NFT collectibles. What’s special? All figures can be built with real life bricks. Series 1 are 1600 unique NFTs, featuring 50 different figures based on the Cardano world. In addition, there will be 1,200 ADAHEADZ Specials released over time on holidays and other special occasions. But ADAHEADZ NFTs are more than collectibles. Our goal is to establish a permanent reward system for our HEADZ Holders. As one of our first benefits for loyal Holders, we provide an opportunity to let design your own ADAHEADZ figure.
